$comment: HIL-1 DRAFT rev 2 (PRD FR-10.1, E71): proposed first non-empty registry commit, derived from the legacy structures (persons/orgs/links of HRM, SBB-GD, SEM v1) and their attribute categories; revised per HIL-1 feedback 2026-07-05 (Kontaktart node type, Gremium kategorie prop, Team/Gremium distinction, explicit kontext:null contract, props.isBasis path notation). Becomes schema/registry.json ONLY after human approval at the bootstrap gate — until then registry.json stays empty (version 0).

Person.description: Individual person. Legacy: persons[] (id, label, email, isBasis).

email.description: Global natural key (E66 join key); sensitive by default (E60).

isBasis.description: Leaf marker driving the leaf filter (FR-8.3). Legacy: persons[].isBasis.

pensum.description: Employment percentage. Legacy: SBB-GD Beschaeftigungsgrad.tsv (numeric, unique per person).

mobil.description: Mobile number. Legacy: SBB-GD Mobilnummer.tsv (unique per person).

AufbauOrg.description: Structural organisation code, shared across persons. Legacy: SBB-GD AufbauOrg.tsv.

Rolle.description: Role, shared and traversable. Legacy: SEM ERZ Rollen Rom/Paris, AKROS values, HRM Funktion.

Team.description: Operative delivery/work group (does the work). Distinction: Gremium is a governance/alignment format. Legacy: SEM ERZ Teams Rom/Paris, SEM Change Team.

Training.description: Training or training cohort/session. Legacy: SEM SAFe Trainings. If cohort vs. course ever matters, split later; one node type suffices for bootstrap.

Gremium.description: Governance/alignment format: board, workshop, committee, voting body (governs/aligns; a Team delivers). Source categories stay distinguishable via props.kategorie without type inflation. Legacy: SEM QRM-Board, GL-Workshop, ISC LACE, SEM_PM, SEM-ISC-Themen, ERZ PA, HRM 12W Retros.

kategorie.description: Source category of the format, e.g. 'QRM-Board', 'GL-Workshop', 'ISC LACE', 'SEM_PM', 'SEM-ISC-Themen', 'ERZ PA', '12W Retros'. Set by the migration from the TSV category (FR-10.2).

Firma.description: External company (context of a role). Legacy: SEM AKROS.tsv — the canonical Kontext+Rolle case (FR-4.6).

Kontaktart.description: Personal contact kind/channel, shared across persons. Reified as a node because the legacy data is multi-valued per person (FR-4.4). Legacy: SEM 'Persönliche Kontakt.tsv'.

berichtetAn.description: Reports to (subordinate -> superior, FR-7.2a). Legacy person->person links are manager->report and get INVERTED by the migration (FR-10.3).

mitgliedIn.description: Member of an OE (person -> container). Legacy person->org links keep their direction (FR-10.3).

unterstellt.description: Sub-OE of (child OE -> parent OE). Legacy org->org links are parent->child and get INVERTED by the migration (FR-10.3).

gehoertZu.description: Belongs to a structural org code.

hatRolle.description: Has role; props.kontext optionally binds the role to a company (double reification, FR-4.6). kontext is an identityProp (E15): the same role at two companies keeps two edge identities. BINDING for producers/migration: context-free roles MUST deliver kontext: null explicitly — omitting an identityProp violates the edge identity contract and is rejected by the import preflight (FR-6.8).

kontext.description: Node reference to the company context (FR-4.7); null (never absent) when the role has no company context.

arbeitetBei.description: Works at a company. Base edge materialized as projection of hatRolle primary facts (FR-4.8, E33); may also stand alone.

besuchte.description: Attended a training; the value (e.g. cohort) stays on the target node label.

hatKontakt.description: Has personal contact kind/channel (multi-valued per person). Legacy: SEM 'Persönliche Kontakt.tsv'.
